identification: Tasmania's War Record 1914-1918, ed. L. Broinowski, intro Maj-Gen Sir J. Gellibrand, J. Walch & Sons for the Government of Tasmania, Hobart, MCMXXI (1921). Title page photo shows genuine 1921 imprint, so this is the first edition (not the later facsimile reprints Noble sold in 1995-2003). Red cloth faded and soiled, circular stain on front board, light foxing to title.

viewing_check: Check the copyright or back of title page and any 'reprint' or 'facsimile' notice (photo shows MCMXXI imprint, so likely a true first). Check hinges and cords, that the 370pp text and all plates and the folding items are present, any ownership inscription or library marks, and the extent of the circular front-board stain and fading.
